candidates.proposed_objective_text: Analyze statistical data given in tables.
candidates.evidence_quote: Use the table to answer the following questions.
candidates.rationale: The textbook includes worked examples and exercises that require learners to read, rank, total, compare, and draw conclusions from statistical tables. That is measurable, but it is not the same as listing purposes of statistics.

candidates.evidence_quote: One source of statistical information would be the results of a survey.
candidates.rationale: The source record asks learners to recognise where statistical information can come from. That is a distinct teachable skill from listing why statistics is useful.
